vulnerability.name: USN-8420-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that .NET did not properly handle link resolution before file access. A local attacker could use this issue to perform unauthorized file tampering and write arbitrary files outside of the intended extraction directory. (CVE-2026-45491)  It was discovered that .NET did not properly handle deeply-nested MessagePack arrays. An attacker could use this to cause .NET to consume excessive resources, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-45591)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in .NET.
